source: Drafted by the operator for the market-index warehouse; aligned with the governed semantic catalog (data/semantic_catalogs/market_data.json, version 1) and live schema on 2026-10-14

terms.definition: One trading-date record for one configured market index in index_prices; the authoritative daily warehouse grain whose privacy-conserving analog is (symbol, trade_date).
caveats: Close is never summed across dates or symbols; it is a non-additive level.
Gaps are missing observations, never forward filled.

terms.definition: Observed daily closing level of an index, in index points; the canonical measure for level questions.
caveats: Adjusted close exists in adj_close; state explicitly before using either.
Not comparable as a return without rebasing.

terms.definition: Cumulative return over the selected window: endpoint close relative to the first valid close of the window per symbol; corresponds to semantic catalog metric cumulative_return.
terms.grain: one series per symbol across the selected window
caveats: Rebase each symbol independently; symbols may enter at different first observations.
Monthly or weekly rollups use the last trading-session endpoint, never an average of closes.

terms.definition: Index level rebased to 100 at the first valid close of the selected window; corresponds to semantic catalog metric normalized_level.
terms.grain: one series per symbol across the selected window
caveats: Always label the base date in the answer or chart.
Prefer this when the user says compare the indices; propose it rather than asserting it.

terms.definition: Return of one trading session relative to the previous available observation per symbol; corresponds to semantic catalog metric daily_return.
terms.formula: close / lag(close) over (partition by symbol order by trade_date) - 1
terms.grain: one value per symbol and trading observation
caveats: Null after data gaps; no interpolation.
Order by trade_date within each symbol partition before lagging.

terms.definition: Annualized dispersion of daily returns for a stated window; corresponds to semantic catalog metric annualized_volatility.
terms.formula: stddev_samp(daily_return) * sqrt(252) over the stated window
terms.grain: one value per symbol per stated window
caveats: The window (rolling versus whole selected window) must be stated or asked, never invented.
Available returns shrink the sample when sessions are missing.

terms.definition: Fraction below the running peak of the normalized level within the window; worst case is max_drawdown.
terms.formula: normalized_level / running_max(normalized_level) - 1; min over the window
terms.grain: one value per symbol per window
caveats: Report negative fractions or magnitudes consistently; say which convention was used.

terms.definition: The observed min and max trade_date per symbol; governs every window question.
caveats: Resolve windows against coverage per symbol before computing returns.
The warehouse updates daily; re-check coverage rather than assuming it.

terms.definition: Reported trading volume for an index observation; upstream availability varies by index.
terms.grain: one value per symbol and trading date
caveats: Confirm a meaningful volume series exists for the requested symbols before aggregating.
